about.title: About Epic Tales Daily
about.html:
Epic Tales Daily brings the great stories of the Ramayana and the Mahabharata to families, one illustrated episode at a time. A new episode is posted every morning, Malaysia time.

Why we started

These stories have been told by grandparents to grandchildren for thousands of years. They carry the values our elders hold dear: truth, courage, kindness, respect for parents and teachers, and faith with a true heart. Many children today grow up far from that circle of storytelling, and busy parents do not always have time to sit down with a long book.

Epic Tales Daily is a small, gentle way to keep that tradition alive. Each day you get one short part of the story that a parent and child can read together in about ten minutes.

What is in every episode

  • Seven original pictures with a short caption under each one
  • The story in full, retold in plain words
  • Today's value: one Sanskrit value, such as Satya, Dharma or Seva, explained simply and tied to what a character did
  • In our tradition: how the episode connects to Hindu practice, scripture and festivals today
  • Words to know: the Sanskrit words and names in the episode, with simple meanings
  • Talk about it: three questions for parents to ask their children

How we tell the stories

We follow the widely told Valmiki Ramayana, and later the Mahabharata of Vyasa, and we do not invent events. Where a detail comes from a later telling, such as the Ramcharitmanas of Tulsidas, we say so. These are sacred texts, and we tell them with respect. Danger is shown, but never in a frightening or gory way, so the stories are suitable for children aged about 8 to 12 reading with a parent, and enjoyable for adults too.

All pictures are original and drawn in our own simple cartoon style.

If you enjoy the episodes, please share them with another family. Have a suggestion or spotted a mistake? Visit our Contact page.

contact.title: Contact
contact.html:
We would love to hear from you. Families, teachers, temple and community groups are all welcome to get in touch.

You can write to us about

  • Feedback on an episode, or a story you would like us to tell
  • A mistake in a name, a detail or a Sanskrit word
  • Using the episodes in a class, a Sunday school or a balvihar
  • Anything else about the site

How to reach us

Email: epictalesdaily21@gmail.com

You can also leave a comment under any episode. Comments are read before they appear, to keep the blog friendly for children.

We usually reply within a few days. Thank you for reading Epic Tales Daily.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.html:
Last updated: 28 November 2026

This page explains what information is collected when you visit Epic Tales Daily (https://epictalesdaily.blogspot.com/) and how it is used.

Information we collect

We do not ask you to sign up, and we do not collect your name, address or other personal details. If you email us, we use your email address only to reply to you. If you leave a comment, your comment and the name on your Google profile are shown with it.

Blogger

This blog is hosted on Blogger, a service of Google. Blogger may collect standard visitor information, such as your browser type and the pages you visit, to run the service and count visits. This is covered by the Google Privacy Policy.

Advertising and cookies

We use Google AdSense to show ads, which helps keep Epic Tales Daily free for everyone.

  • Third party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites.
  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to our users based on their visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • You may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Ads Settings. You can also opt out of some third party vendors' use of cookies for personalised advertising at www.aboutads.info.

To learn more, see how Google uses information from sites that use its services. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings.

Children

Epic Tales Daily is made for families, and we encourage children to read it together with a parent or guardian. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, please contact us and we will delete it.

Links to other sites

Some pages link to other websites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

Changes to this policy

If this policy changes, we will update this page and the date at the top.

Contact

Questions about this policy: epictalesdaily21@gmail.com
